verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיִּקְרָ֖א מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל־ מֵאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ê·lāw way·yiq·rā mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mê·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting saying

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ אָדָ֗ם מִכֶּ֛ם יַקְרִ֥יב קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ אֶת־ קָרְבַּנְכֶֽם׃ מִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֗ה מִן־ הַבָּקָר֙ וּמִן־ הַצֹּ֔אן
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî- ’ā·ḏām mik·kem yaq·rîḇ qār·bān Yah·weh taq·rî·ḇū ’eṯ- qā·rə·ban·ḵem min- hab·bə·hê·māh min- hab·bā·qār ū·min- haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them When any of you brings an offering to the LORD you may bring - as your offering an animal from the herd . . . or the flock

verses.original: אִם־ קָרְבָּנוֹ֙ עֹלָ֤ה מִן־ הַבָּקָ֔ר יַקְרִיבֶ֑נּוּ תָּמִ֖ים זָכָ֥ר יַקְרִ֣יב אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־ פֶּ֝תַח אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לִרְצֹנ֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- qā·rə·bā·nōw ‘ō·lāh min- hab·bā·qār yaq·rî·ḇen·nū tā·mîm zā·ḵār yaq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯōw ’el- pɛ·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lir·ṣō·nōw lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd he is to present an unblemished male He must bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for its acceptance before the LORD

verses.original: וְסָמַ֣ךְ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִרְצָ֥ה ל֖וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ yā·ḏōw ‘al rōš hā·‘ō·lāh wə·nir·ṣāh lōw lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering so it can be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־ בֶּ֥ן הַבָּקָ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַהֲרֹ֤ן בְּנֵ֨י הַֽכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֶת־ וְ֠הִקְרִיבוּ הַדָּ֔ם וְזָרְק֨וּ אֶת־ הַדָּ֤ם סָבִ֔יב עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- ben hab·bā·qār lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’a·hă·rōn bə·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- wə·hiq·rî·ḇū had·dām wə·zā·rə·qū ’eṯ- had·dām sā·ḇîḇ ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: And he shall slaughter - the young bull before the LORD and Aaron’s sons the priests - are to present the blood and splatter - it on all sides of the altar - at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְהִפְשִׁ֖יט אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֑ה וְנִתַּ֥ח אֹתָ֖הּ לִנְתָחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.literal: Next, he is to skin - the burnt offering and cut - it into pieces

verses.original: בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְ֠נָתְנוּ אֵ֖שׁ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעָרְכ֥וּ עֵצִ֖ים עַל־ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’êš ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·‘ā·rə·ḵū ‘ê·ṣîm ‘al- hā·’êš
verses.literal: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put a fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire

verses.original: אַהֲרֹן֙ בְּנֵ֤י הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אֵ֚ת וְעָרְכ֗וּ הַנְּתָחִ֔ים אֶת־ הָרֹ֖אשׁ וְאֶת־ הַפָּ֑דֶר עַל־ הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הָעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn bə·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm ’êṯ wə·‘ā·rə·ḵū han·nə·ṯā·ḥîm ’eṯ- hā·rōš wə·’eṯ- hap·pā·ḏer ‘al- hā·’êš ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·‘ê·ṣîm ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then Aaron’s sons the priests - are to arrange the pieces - including the head - and the fat atop the burning - - wood - on the altar

verses.original: וְקִרְבּ֥וֹ וּכְרָעָ֖יו יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה נִיח֖וֹחַ רֵֽיחַ־ לַֽיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·qir·bōw ū·ḵə·rā·‘āw yir·ḥaṣ bam·mā·yim hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·hiq·ṭîr hak·kōl ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ‘ō·lāh ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·w·aḥ rê·aḥ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: The entrails and legs must be washed with water and the priest - shall burn all of it on the altar as a burnt offering a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וְאִם־ קָרְבָּנ֧וֹ לְעֹלָ֑ה מִן־ הַצֹּ֨אן מִן־ הַכְּשָׂבִ֛ים א֥וֹ מִן־ הָעִזִּ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃ תָּמִ֖ים זָכָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- qā·rə·bā·nōw lə·‘ō·lāh min- haṣ·ṣōn min- hak·kə·śā·ḇîm ’ōw min- hā·‘iz·zîm yaq·rî·ḇen·nū tā·mîm zā·ḵār
verses.literal: If, however one’s offering is a burnt offering from the flock from the sheep or . . . goats he is to present an unblemished male

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֨ט אֹת֜וֹ עַ֣ל צָפֹ֖נָה יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַהֲרֹ֨ן בְּנֵי֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת־ וְזָרְק֡וּ דָּמ֛וֹ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’ō·ṯōw ‘al ṣā·p̄ō·nāh ye·reḵ ham·miz·bê·aḥ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’a·hă·rōn bə·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- wə·zā·rə·qū dā·mōw ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: He shall slaughter - it on the north side of the altar before the LORD and Aaron’s sons the priests - are to splatter its blood against the altar on all sides

verses.original: וְנִתַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ לִנְתָחָ֔יו הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְעָרַ֤ךְ אֹתָ֔ם וְאֶת־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ פִּדְר֑וֹ עַל־ הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הָֽעֵצִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nit·taḥ ’ō·ṯōw lin·ṯā·ḥāw hak·kō·hên wə·‘ā·raḵ ’ō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- rō·šōw wə·’eṯ- piḏ·rōw ‘al- hā·’êš ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·‘ê·ṣîm ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: He is to cut [the animal] into pieces and the priest shall arrange them including the head - and fat atop the burning - - wood that [is] on the altar

verses.original: וְהַקֶּ֥רֶב וְהַכְּרָעַ֖יִם יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־ וְהִקְרִ֨יב הַכֹּל֙ וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה ה֗וּא עֹלָ֣ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵ֥יחַ לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·qe·reḇ wə·hak·kə·rā·‘a·yim yir·ḥaṣ bam·mā·yim hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·hiq·rîḇ hak·kōl wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh hū ‘ō·lāh ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The entrails and legs must be washed with water and the priest - shall present all of it and burn [it] on the altar it is a burnt offering a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וְאִ֧ם קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֹלָ֥ה מִן־ הָע֛וֹף וְהִקְרִ֣יב קָרְבָּנֽוֹ׃ מִן־ הַתֹּרִ֗ים א֛וֹ מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י הַיּוֹנָ֖ה אֶת־
verses.transliteration: wə·’im qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh ‘ō·lāh min- hā·‘ō·wp̄ wə·hiq·rîḇ qā·rə·bā·nōw min- hat·tō·rîm ’ōw min- bə·nê hay·yō·w·nāh ’eṯ-
verses.literal: If, instead one’s offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds he is to present . . . . . . a turtledove or . . . a young pigeon -

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְהִקְרִיב֤וֹ אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּמָלַק֙ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה דָמ֔וֹ וְנִמְצָ֣ה עַ֖ל קִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·hiq·rî·ḇōw ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ū·mā·laq ’eṯ- rō·šōw wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ḏā·mōw wə·nim·ṣāh ‘al qîr ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then the priest shall bring it to the altar twist off - its head and burn it on the altar its blood should be drained out on the side of the altar

verses.original: וְהֵסִ֥יר אֶת־ מֻרְאָת֖וֹ בְּנֹצָתָ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜הּ קֵ֔דְמָה אֵ֤צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ אֶל־ מְק֖וֹם הַדָּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·sîr ’eṯ- mur·’ā·ṯōw bə·nō·ṣā·ṯāh wə·hiš·lîḵ ’ō·ṯāh qê·ḏə·māh ’ê·ṣel ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’el- mə·qō·wm had·dā·šen
verses.literal: And he is to remove - the crop with its contents and throw it to the east side of the altar in the place for ashes

verses.original: וְשִׁסַּ֨ע אֹת֣וֹ בִכְנָפָיו֮ לֹ֣א יַבְדִּיל֒ הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְהִקְטִ֨יר אֹת֤וֹ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַל־ הָאֵ֑שׁ הָעֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ ה֗וּא עֹלָ֣ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵ֥יחַ לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šis·sa‘ ’ō·ṯōw ḇiḵ·nā·p̄āw lō yaḇ·dîl hak·kō·hên wə·hiq·ṭîr ’ō·ṯōw ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ‘al- hā·’êš hā·‘ê·ṣîm ’ă·šer ‘al- hū ‘ō·lāh ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: He shall tear it open - by its wings without dividing [ the bird ] completely And the priest is to burn it on the altar atop the burning wood - - It is a burnt offering a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
